verses.original: Τῇ δὲ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων ὄρθρου βαθέως ἐπὶ τὸ μνῆμα ἦλθον φέρουσαι ἃ ἡτοίμασαν ἀρώματα
verses.transliteration: Tē de mia tōn sabbatōn orthrou batheōs epi to mnēma ēlthon pherousai ha hētoimasan arōmata
verses.literal: On the first day of the week very early in the morning the women came to the tomb bringing the spices they had prepared
verses.literalPt: E NO primeiro dia da semana, muito de madrugada, foram elas ao sepulcro, levando as especiarias que tinham preparado, e algumas outras com elas.

verses.original: εὗρον δὲ τὸν λίθον ἀποκεκυλισμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: heuron de ton lithon apokekylismenon apo tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb
verses.literalPt: E acharam a pedra revolvida do sepulcro.

verses.original: εἰσελθοῦσαι δὲ οὐχ εὗρον τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: eiselthousai de ouch heuron to sōma tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: but when they entered they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus
verses.literalPt: E, entrando, não acharam o corpo do Senhor Jesus.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀπορεῖσθαι αὐτὰς περὶ τούτου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο ἐπέστησαν αὐταῖς ἐν ἐσθῆτι ἀστραπτούσῃ
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō aporeisthai autas peri toutou kai idou andres dyo epestēsan autais en esthēti astraptousē
verses.literal: While they were puzzling over this suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, estando elas muito perplexas a esse respeito, eis que pararam junto delas dois homens, com vestes resplandecentes. 5 E, estando elas muito atemorizadas, e abaixando o rosto para o chão, eles lhes disseram: Por que buscais o vivente entre os mortos?

verses.original: ἐμφόβων δὲ γενομένων αὐτῶν καὶ κλινουσῶν τὰ πρόσωπα εἰς τὴν γῆν εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτάς Τί ζητεῖτε τὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τῶν νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: emphobōn de genomenōn autōn kai klinousōn ta prosōpa eis tēn gēn eipan pros autas Ti zēteite ton zōnta meta tōn nekrōn
verses.literal: As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror the two men asked . . . them Why do you look for the living among the dead
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε ἀλλὰ ἠγέρθη μνήσθητε ὡς ἐλάλησεν ὑμῖν ἔτι ὢν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ouk estin hōde alla ēgerthē mnēsthēte hōs elalēsen hymin eti ōn en tē Galilaia
verses.literal: He is not here He has risen Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee
verses.literalPt: Não está aqui, mas ressuscitou. Lembrai-vos como vos falou, estando ainda na Galiléia,

verses.original: λέγων Τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὅτι δεῖ παραδοθῆναι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ σταυρωθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀναστῆναι
verses.transliteration: legōn Ton Huion tou anthrōpou hoti dei paradothēnai eis cheiras anthrōpōn hamartōlōn kai staurōthēnai kai tē tritē hēmera anastēnai
verses.literal: The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men and be crucified and on the third day rise again
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Convém que o Filho do homem seja entregue nas mãos de homens pecadores, e seja crucificado, e ao terceiro dia ressuscite.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν τῶν ῥημάτων αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai emnēsthēsan tōn rhēmatōn autou
verses.literal: Then they remembered His words
verses.literalPt: E lembraram-se das suas palavras.

verses.original: καὶ ὑποστρέψασαι ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπήγγειλαν ταῦτα πάντα τοῖς ἕνδεκα καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς λοιποῖς
verses.transliteration: kai hypostrepsasai apo tou mnēmeiou apēngeilan tauta panta tois hendeka kai pasin tois loipois
verses.literal: And when they returned from the tomb they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others
verses.literalPt: E, voltando do sepulcro, anunciaram todas estas coisas aos onze e a todos os demais.

verses.original: ἦσαν δὲ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ Μαρία καὶ Ἰωάννα καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ σὺν αὐταῖς ἔλεγον πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: ēsan de hē Magdalēnē Maria kai Iōanna kai Maria hē Iakōbou kai hai loipai syn autais elegon pros tous apostolous tauta
verses.literal: It was Mary Magdalene Joanna Mary the mother of James and the other women with them who told this to the apostles
verses.literalPt: E eram Maria Madalena, e Joana, e Maria, mãe de Tiago, e as outras que com elas estavam, as que diziam estas coisas aos apóstolos.

verses.original: καὶ ἐφάνησαν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λῆρος τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ ἠπίστουν αὐταῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ephanēsan enōpion autōn hōsei lēros ta rhēmata tauta kai ēpistoun autais
verses.literal: But their words seemed like nonsense to them and they did not believe the women
verses.literalPt: E as suas palavras lhes pareciam como desvario, e não as creram.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἀναστὰς ἔδραμεν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει τὰ ὀθόνια μόνα καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὑτὸν θαυμάζων τὸ γεγονός
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros anastas edramen epi to mnēmeion kai parakypsas blepei ta othonia mona kai apēlthen pros hauton thaumazōn to gegonos
verses.literal: Peter however got up and ran to the tomb And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths he went away wondering to himself what had happened
verses.literalPt: Pedro, porém, levantando-se, correu ao sepulcro e, abaixando-se, viu só os lençóis ali postos; e retirou-se, admirando consigo aquele caso.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἦσαν πορευόμενοι εἰς κώμην ἀπέχουσαν σταδίους ἑξήκοντα ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ ᾗ ὄνομα Ἐμμαοῦς
verses.transliteration: Kai idou dyo ex autōn en autē tē hēmera ēsan poreuomenoi eis kōmēn apechousan stadious hexēkonta apo Ierousalēm hē onoma Emmaous
verses.literal: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus about seven miles . . . . . . from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E eis que no mesmo dia iam dois deles para uma aldeia, que distava de Jerusalém sessenta estádios, cujo nome era Emaús.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡμίλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους περὶ πάντων τῶν συμβεβηκότων τούτων
verses.transliteration: kai autoi hōmiloun pros allēlous peri pantōn tōn symbebēkotōn toutōn
verses.literal: They were talking with each other about everything . . . that had happened
verses.literalPt: E iam falando entre si de tudo aquilo que havia sucedido.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὁμιλεῖν αὐτοὺς καὶ συζητεῖν καὶ αὐτὸς Ἰησοῦς ἐγγίσας συνεπορεύετο αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō homilein autous kai syzētein kai autos Iēsous engisas syneporeueto autois
verses.literal: And as they talked and deliberated Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, indo eles falando entre si, e fazendo perguntas um ao outro, o mesmo Jesus se aproximou, e ia com eles.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν ἐκρατοῦντο τοῦ μὴ ἐπιγνῶναι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: hoi de ophthalmoi autōn ekratounto tou mē epignōnai auton
verses.literal: But their eyes were kept . . . from recognizing Him
verses.literalPt: Mas os olhos deles estavam como que fechados, para que o não conhecessem.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Τίνες οἱ λόγοι οὗτοι οὓς ἀντιβάλλετε πρὸς ἀλλήλους περιπατοῦντες Καὶ ἐστάθησαν σκυθρωποί
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros autous Tines hoi logoi houtoi hous antiballete pros allēlous peripatountes Kai estathēsan skythrōpoi
verses.literal: He asked them What are you discussing so intently . . . . . . as you walk along They stood still with sadness on their faces
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Que palavras são essas que, caminhando, trocais entre vós, e por que estais tristes?

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἷς ὀνόματι Κλεοπᾶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Σὺ μόνος παροικεῖς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνως τὰ γενόμενα ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις
verses.transliteration: apokritheis de heis onomati Kleopas eipen pros auton Sy monos paroikeis Ierousalēm kai ouk egnōs ta genomena en autē en tais hēmerais tautais
verses.literal: One of them named Cleopas asked . . . . . . Him Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo um, cujo nome era Cléopas, disse-lhe: És tu só peregrino em Jerusalém, e não sabes as coisas que nela têm sucedido nestes dias?

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ποῖα οἱ Δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τὰ περὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ ὃς ἐγένετο ἀνὴρ προφήτης δυνατὸς ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἐναντίον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Poia hoi De eipan autō Ta peri Iēsou tou Nazarēnou hos egeneto anēr prophētēs dynatos en ergō kai logō enantion tou Theou kai pantos tou laou
verses.literal: What things He asked The events involving Jesus of Nazareth - they answered This man was a prophet powerful in speech and action before God and all the people
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes perguntou: Quais? E eles lhe disseram: As que dizem respeito a Jesus Nazareno, que foi homem profeta, poderoso em obras e palavras diante de Deus e de todo o povo;

verses.original: ὅπως τε παρέδωκαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν εἰς κρίμα θανάτου καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: hopōs te paredōkan auton hoi archiereis kai hoi archontes hēmōn eis krima thanatou kai estaurōsan auton
verses.literal: Our chief priests and - rulers delivered Him up . . . to the sentence of death and they crucified Him
verses.literalPt: E como os principais dos sacerdotes e os nossos príncipes o entregaram à condenação de morte, e o crucificaram.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἠλπίζομεν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ μέλλων λυτροῦσθαι τὸν Ἰσραήλ ἀλλά γε καὶ σὺν πᾶσιν τούτοις τρίτην ταύτην ἡμέραν ἄγει ἀφ’ οὗ ταῦτα ἐγένετο
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de ēlpizomen hoti autos estin ho mellōn lytrousthai ton Israēl alla ge kai syn pasin toutois tritēn tautēn hēmeran agei aph’ hou tauta egeneto
verses.literal: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel And besides all this it is the third day since . . . these things took place
verses.literalPt: E nós esperávamos que fosse ele o que remisse Israel; mas agora, sobre tudo isso, é já hoje o terceiro dia desde que essas coisas aconteceram.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ καὶ γυναῖκές τινες ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξέστησαν ἡμᾶς γενόμεναι ὀρθριναὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: Alla kai gynaikes tines ex hēmōn exestēsan hēmas genomenai orthrinai epi to mnēmeion
verses.literal: Furthermore some of our women astounded us They were at the tomb early this morning
verses.literalPt: É verdade que também algumas mulheres dentre nós nos maravilharam, as quais de madrugada foram ao sepulcro;

verses.original: καὶ μὴ εὑροῦσαι τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἦλθον λέγουσαι καὶ ὀπτασίαν ἀγγέλων ἑωρακέναι οἳ λέγουσιν αὐτὸν ζῆν
verses.transliteration: kai mē heurousai to sōma autou ēlthon legousai kai optasian angelōn heōrakenai hoi legousin auton zēn
verses.literal: but they did not find His body They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels who said that Jesus was alive
verses.literalPt: E, não achando o seu corpo, voltaram, dizendo que também tinham visto uma visão de anjos, que dizem que ele vive.

verses.original: καὶ ἀπῆλθόν τινες τῶν σὺν ἡμῖν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ εὗρον οὕτως καθὼς καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες εἶπον αὐτὸν δὲ οὐκ εἶδον
verses.transliteration: kai apēlthon tines tōn syn hēmin epi to mnēmeion kai heuron houtōs kathōs kai hai gynaikes eipon auton de ouk eidon
verses.literal: Then some of our companions . . . . . . went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described But Him they did not see
verses.literalPt: E alguns dos que estavam conosco foram ao sepulcro, e acharam ser assim como as mulheres haviam dito; porém, a ele não o viram.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ὦ ἀνόητοι καὶ βραδεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦ πιστεύειν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐλάλησαν οἱ προφῆται
verses.transliteration: Kai autos eipen pros autous Ō anoētoi kai bradeis tē kardia tou pisteuein epi pasin hois elalēsan hoi prophētai
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to them O foolish ones and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Ó néscios, e tardos de coração para crer tudo o que os profetas disseram!

verses.original: οὐχὶ ταῦτα ἔδει παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν καὶ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ouchi tauta edei pathein ton Christon kai eiselthein eis tēn doxan autou
verses.literal: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter . . . His glory
verses.literalPt: Porventura não convinha que o Cristo padecesse estas coisas e entrasse na sua glória?

verses.original: καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ Μωϋσέως καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν προφητῶν διερμήνευσεν αὐτοῖς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς γραφαῖς τὰ περὶ ἑαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai arxamenos apo Mōuseōs kai apo pantōn tōn prophētōn diermēneusen autois en pasais tais graphais ta peri heautou
verses.literal: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself
verses.literalPt: E, começando por Moisés, e por todos os profetas, explicava-lhes o que dele se achava em todas as Escrituras.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤγγισαν εἰς τὴν κώμην οὗ ἐπορεύοντο καὶ αὐτὸς προσεποιήσατο πορρώτερον πορεύεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Kai ēngisan eis tēn kōmēn hou eporeuonto kai autos prosepoiēsato porrōteron poreuesthai
verses.literal: As they approached . . . the village where they were headed He seemed to be going farther
verses.literalPt: E chegaram à aldeia para onde iam, e ele fez como quem ia para mais longe.

verses.original: καὶ παρεβιάσαντο αὐτὸν λέγοντες Μεῖνον μεθ’ ἡμῶν ὅτι πρὸς ἑσπέραν ἐστὶν καὶ κέκλικεν ἤδη ἡ ἡμέρα Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν τοῦ μεῖναι σὺν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai parebiasanto auton legontes Meinon meth’ hēmōn hoti pros hesperan estin kai kekliken ēdē hē hēmera Kai eisēlthen tou meinai syn autois
verses.literal: But they pleaded with Him . . . . . . Stay with us for it is nearly evening and . . . the day is almost over So He went in to stay with them
verses.literalPt: E eles o constrangeram, dizendo: Fica conosco, porque já é tarde, e já declinou o dia. E entrou para ficar com eles.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κατακλιθῆναι αὐτὸν μετ’ αὐτῶν λαβὼν τὸν ἄρτον εὐλόγησεν καὶ κλάσας ἐπεδίδου αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō kataklithēnai auton met’ autōn labōn ton arton eulogēsen kai klasas epedidou autois
verses.literal: While . . . . . . He was reclining at the table with them He took bread spoke a blessing and broke it and gave it to them
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, estando com eles à mesa, tomando o pão, o abençoou e partiu-o, e lho deu.

verses.original: αὐτῶν δὲ διηνοίχθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἄφαντος ἐγένετο ἀπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: autōn de diēnoichthēsan hoi ophthalmoi kai epegnōsan auton kai autos aphantos egeneto ap’ autōn
verses.literal: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Jesus and He disappeared from their sight
verses.literalPt: Abriram-se-lhes então os olhos, e o conheceram, e ele desapareceu-lhes.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Οὐχὶ ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν καιομένη ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν ὡς ἐλάλει ἡμῖν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ὡς διήνοιγεν ἡμῖν τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: Kai eipan pros allēlous Ouchi hē kardia hēmōn kaiomenē ēn en hēmin hōs elalei hēmin en tē hodō hōs diēnoigen hēmin tas graphas
verses.literal: They asked each other Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us
verses.literalPt: E disseram um para o outro: Porventura não ardia em nós o nosso coração quando, pelo caminho, nos falava, e quando nos abria as Escrituras?

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστάντες αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ καὶ εὗρον ἠθροισμένους τοὺς ἕνδεκα καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai anastantes autē tē hōra hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm kai heuron ēthroismenous tous hendeka kai tous syn autois
verses.literal: And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem There they found the Eleven and those with them gathered together
verses.literalPt: E na mesma hora, levantando-se, tornaram para Jerusalém, e acharam congregados os onze, e os que estavam com eles,

verses.original: λέγοντας ὅτι Ὄντως ἠγέρθη ὁ Κύριος καὶ ὤφθη Σίμωνι
verses.transliteration: legontas hoti Ontōs ēgerthē ho Kyrios kai ōphthē Simōni
verses.literal: and saying The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon
verses.literalPt: Os quais diziam: Ressuscitou verdadeiramente o Senhor, e já apareceu a Simão.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐξηγοῦντο τὰ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὡς ἐγνώσθη αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου
verses.transliteration: Kai autoi exēgounto ta en tē hodō kai hōs egnōsthē autois en tē klasei tou artou
verses.literal: Then the two told what had happened on the road and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread
verses.literalPt: E eles lhes contaram o que lhes acontecera no caminho, e como deles fora conhecido no partir do pão.

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτῶν λαλούντων αὐτὸς ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Tauta de autōn lalountōn autos estē en mesō autōn kai legei autois Eirēnē hymin
verses.literal: While they were describing these events Jesus Himself stood among them and said . . . Peace be with you
verses.literalPt: E falando eles destas coisas, o mesmo Jesus se apresentou no meio deles, e disse-lhes: Paz seja convosco.

verses.original: πτοηθέντες δὲ καὶ ἔμφοβοι γενόμενοι ἐδόκουν πνεῦμα θεωρεῖν
verses.transliteration: ptoēthentes de kai emphoboi genomenoi edokoun pneuma theōrein
verses.literal: But they were startled and frightened thinking they had seen a spirit
verses.literalPt: E eles, espantados e atemorizados, pensavam que viam algum espírito.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί τεταραγμένοι ἐστέ καὶ διὰ τί διαλογισμοὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Ti tetaragmenoi este kai dia ti dialogismoi anabainousin en tē kardia hymōn
verses.literal: Why are you troubled Jesus asked . . . and why . . . do doubts arise in your hearts
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Por que estais perturbados, e por que sobem tais pensamentos aos vossos corações?

verses.original: ἴδετε τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι αὐτός ψηλαφήσατέ με καὶ ἴδετε ὅτι πνεῦμα σάρκα καὶ ὀστέα οὐκ ἔχει καθὼς ἐμὲ θεωρεῖτε ἔχοντα
verses.transliteration: idete tas cheiras mou kai tous podas mou hoti egō eimi autos psēlaphēsate me kai idete hoti pneuma sarka kai ostea ouk echei kathōs eme theōreite echonta
verses.literal: Look at My hands and My feet It is I Myself Touch Me and see for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have
verses.literalPt: Vede as minhas mãos e os meus pés, que sou eu mesmo; apalpai-me e vede, pois um espírito não tem carne nem ossos, como vedes que eu tenho.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας
verses.transliteration: kai touto eipōn edeixen autois tas cheiras kai tous podas
verses.literal: And when He had said this He showed them His hands and feet
verses.literalPt: E, dizendo isto, mostrou-lhes as mãos e os pés.

verses.original: Ἔτι δὲ ἀπιστούντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς καὶ θαυμαζόντων εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἔχετέ τι βρώσιμον ἐνθάδε
verses.transliteration: Eti de apistountōn autōn apo tēs charas kai thaumazontōn eipen autois Echete ti brōsimon enthade
verses.literal: While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement He asked them Do you have anything here to eat
verses.literalPt: E, não o crendo eles ainda por causa da alegria, e estando maravilhados, disse-lhes: Tendes aqui alguma coisa que comer?

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐπέδωκαν αὐτῷ ἰχθύος ὀπτοῦ μέρος
verses.transliteration: hoi de epedōkan autō ichthyos optou meros
verses.literal: So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish
verses.literalPt: Então eles apresentaram-lhe parte de um peixe assado, e um favo de mel;

verses.original: καὶ λαβὼν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ἔφαγεν
verses.transliteration: kai labōn enōpion autōn ephagen
verses.literal: and He took it and ate it in front of them
verses.literalPt: O que ele tomou, e comeu diante deles.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι μου οὓς ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἔτι ὢν σὺν ὑμῖν ὅτι δεῖ πληρωθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσέως καὶ τοῖς προφήταις καὶ ψαλμοῖς περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros autous Houtoi hoi logoi mou hous elalēsa pros hymas eti ōn syn hymin hoti dei plērōthēnai panta ta gegrammena en tō nomō Mōuseōs kai tois prophētais kai psalmois peri emou
verses.literal: Jesus said to them These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses the Prophets and the Psalms
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: São estas as palavras que vos disse estando ainda convosco: Que convinha que se cumprisse tudo o que de mim estava escrito na lei de Moisés, e nos profetas e nos Salmos.

verses.original: τότε διήνοιξεν αὐτῶν τὸν νοῦν τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: tote diēnoixen autōn ton noun tou synienai tas graphas
verses.literal: Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures
verses.literalPt: Então abriu-lhes o entendimento para compreenderem as Escrituras.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Οὕτως γέγραπται παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois hoti Houtōs gegraptai pathein ton Christon kai anastēnai ek nekrōn tē tritē hēmera
verses.literal: And He told them This is what is written The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Assim está escrito, e assim convinha que o Cristo padecesse, e ao terceiro dia ressuscitasse dentre os mortos,

verses.original: καὶ κηρυχθῆναι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ μετάνοιαν εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: kai kērychthēnai epi tō onomati autou metanoian eis aphesin hamartiōn eis panta ta ethnē arxamenoi apo Ierousalēm
verses.literal: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations beginning in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E em seu nome se pregasse o arrependimento e a remissão dos pecados, em todas as nações, começando por Jerusalém.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε μάρτυρες τούτων
verses.transliteration: hymeis este martyres toutōn
verses.literal: You are witnesses of these things
verses.literalPt: E destas coisas sois vós testemunhas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πατρός μου ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ὑμεῖς δὲ καθίσατε ἐν τῇ πόλει ἕως οὗ ἐνδύσησθε ἐξ ὕψους δύναμιν
verses.transliteration: Kai idou egō exapostellō tēn epangelian tou Patros mou eph’ hymas hymeis de kathisate en tē polei heōs hou endysēsthe ex hypsous dynamin
verses.literal: And behold I am sending the promise of My Father upon you But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high
verses.literalPt: E eis que sobre vós envio a promessa de meu Pai; ficai, porém, na cidade de Jerusalém, até que do alto sejais revestidos de poder.

verses.original: Ἐξήγαγεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔξω ἕως πρὸς Βηθανίαν καὶ ἐπάρας τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Exēgagen de autous exō heōs pros Bēthanian kai eparas tas cheiras autou eulogēsen autous
verses.literal: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany He lifted up His hands and blessed them
verses.literalPt: E levou-os fora, até Betânia; e, levantando as suas mãos, os abençoou.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτὸν αὐτοὺς διέστη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνεφέρετο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō eulogein auton autous diestē ap’ autōn kai anephereto eis ton ouranon
verses.literal: While . . . . . . He was blessing them He left . . . them and was carried up into heaven
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, abençoando-os ele, se apartou deles e foi elevado ao céu.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ προσκυνήσαντες αὐτὸν ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ μετὰ χαρᾶς μεγάλης
verses.transliteration: kai autoi proskynēsantes auton hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm meta charas megalēs
verses.literal: And they worshiped Him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy
verses.literalPt: E, adorando-o eles, tornaram com grande júbilo para Jerusalém.

verses.original: καὶ ἦσαν διὰ παντὸς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὐλογοῦντες τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: kai ēsan dia pantos en tō hierō eulogountes ton Theon
verses.literal: praising God continually . . . in the temple
verses.literalPt: E estavam sempre no templo, louvando e bendizendo a Deus. Amém.
